items: 8-K: Huang resigned as President, CEO and director effective immediately (accepted 2026-11-11); no reason stated, no disagreement reported. Kress interim CEO and CFO; Harvey C. Jones Chair; search for permanent CEO.

Succession: reports NVIDIA approached Arm CEO Rene Haas; Google Cloud's Thomas Kurian reported considered; board says no formal contact yet, still choosing a search firm. Trump suggested Tim Cook. Petition to reinstate Huang passed 135,000 signatures.

Congress: three House chairs (Mast, Moolenaar, Crawford) requested a closed-door briefing from Huang on 2026-11-18 (voluntary, not a subpoena); CNBC reported Huang agreed to testify before Thanksgiving. No charges against Huang, Nvidia, Megaspeed or Alice Huang.

Megaspeed (Sun 2026-11-15): Alice Huang left 2025-08-30, no current role; Megaspeed hired outside lawyers for an internal investigation; denies wrongdoing. Bloomberg (Fri): a Chinese company founded by Alice Huang procured banned Nvidia chips (22 Dell H800 servers, 52 Super Micro H100/H200 servers) at a Shanghai data center; Nvidia declined comment.

WSJ: Southeast Asia cloud channel gives Chinese firms legal remote access; Megaspeed arranged ~$12B of Nvidia chip shipments to Chinese companies Mar 2024-Jun 2025 (documents do not establish delivery); Commerce developing rules for Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore; Malaysia investigating re-exports. Nvidia China revenue $12.4B in six months to Jul 26.

NYT: Commerce Secretary Lutnick favours narrower controls (seven countries, future shipments only, notification not licensing for some Chinese training); other officials favour worldwide restrictions. No rule enacted.

FT: shareholder class action filed against Nvidia and Huang (alleged misleading statements); Nvidia's D&O cover is Side A only (up to $900M), no Side B/C, so corporate defence costs/damages may be uninsured.

Analysts: at least six downgrades Thu-Fri (Truist, Melius, Oppenheimer, Bernstein; HSBC to Hold, target 170); Barclays target 210; Yorkville Ives target 300 -> 225 (Buy). Six straight weekly declines, longest since Oct 2012.
Options: implied earnings move about 9.1% either way (Benzinga Pro). Company guide for the quarter $108B +/-2%; consensus about $109.2B revenue, EPS $2.48.
Customers say Nvidia chips remain preferred despite expected near-term shortages; some considering rival servers.

Context carried from the 2026-11-12 run (sources then: WSJ/Dow Jones, NYT via TheNextWeb, Reuters): the board opened an independent investigation (Wachtell Lipton) into whether Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation; a DOJ inquiry into whether Megaspeed routed Nvidia chips to China was reported (Commerce/BIS probe moved to DOJ). No finding or charge reported as of 2026-11-15.
